caption:
Asian Style Oats 
filling breakfast option | low effort | high carb 

Nutrition: 
C: 50 | F: 14 | P: 14
Calories: 379 per serve
Serves 1 or even 2 
(divide the oats into 2 bowls and add on 2 fried eggs per bowl, adds more protein and cuts the carbs by half) 

Ingredients
1/4 tsp chilli oil
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 inch ginger, grated/minced
1/2 onion, sliced - i use white onions but you can spring onions too
1/2 cup oats 
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tsp vinegar 
1 1/2 cups vegetable OR chicken stock is best, but if you dont have any, normal water will work 
but you will need to add in some salt + pepper

method 
add oil + garlic + ginger + onion in a pan and cook for a few minutes
add the oats and the vege stock along with the soy and vinegar and mix together
cook for 5-10 minutes till oats are mushy
add the egg to the pan after oats are cooked and either scrable it in the oats OR add a fried egg after the oats are out fo the pan and top it 
enjoy :)
